summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the exchange-rate determination for its second interim dividend for the 2026 financial year, originally approved by the board on 4 August 2026 at US$0.10 per ordinary share. The dividend is payable in cash on 25 September 2026 to holders of record on 14 August 2026, converted at forward rates quoted by HSBC Bank plc in London on 14 September 2026: approximately HK$0.784088 or £0.074134 per share, and US$0.50 per American Depositary Share. No advisor was named. Watch for the record-date payment mechanics and ADS ratio of five ordinary shares per ADS.
